summary: Phase 2A5 Encounter START/STOP/RESUME toggle backend fully green (9/9). Frontend passes the Patients-side flow (enter-encounter-btn label is 'Enter Encounter', no 'Start Encounter' text, no auto type-dialog on enter, READY state renders with both green START VISIT toggles synchronised, SOAP disabled, encounter-ready-hint visible, Cancel keeps READY, type-dialog Continue creates visit and navigates to /internal/encounter/{id}, both toggles become RED STOP VISIT, autosave 'Saved' after typing). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG CONFIRMED: the RUNNING timer in [data-testid=encounter-timer] does NOT increment over time. Direct server verification shows backend timer is correct (elapsed_seconds=123 for a visit after ~2 min RUNNING; running_since & server_time populated; stop/resume accumulate properly, PAUSED freezes exact value). The bug is in /app/frontend/src/encounter/SafetyHeader.jsx useElapsed(): `const skew = new Date(serverTime).getTime() - Date.now()` is recomputed on every render using the CURRENT Date.now(), so `Math.max(now, Date.now()) + skew` collapses to `serverTime` (the Date.now() terms cancel). Therefore the displayed elapsed is pinned to `max(0, serverTime - running_since)` at fetch time and never ticks up. Consequence: for a fresh RUNNING visit (server_time ≈ running_since) the UI shows 00:00:00 indefinitely. PAUSED works correctly because secs is read directly from server-stored elapsed_seconds. Re-entry redirect, PAUSED timer freeze (frozen value correct), SOAP disable in READY / enable in RUNNING all verified visually.

ui_bugs.issue: RUNNING timer does not tick up — Date.now() cancels in skew term, so elapsed is pinned to (serverTime - running_since) at fetch time. Fresh RUNNING visit shows 00:00:00 forever. Reload while RUNNING will show (serverTime_at_reload - running_since) but still won't tick up afterwards.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/encounter/SafetyHeader.jsx useElapsed(). Capture mount time once (useRef or state) and compute: `const serverNow = new Date(serverTime).getTime() + (now - mountedAt); secs += Math.max(0, Math.floor((serverNow - new Date(running_since).getTime()) / 1000));`. Alternatively capture `skew` once in useRef on first render (so it doesn't recompute each render). Current formula collapses Date.now() terms and freezes the display.

rca of the issue: In /app/frontend/src/encounter/SafetyHeader.jsx useElapsed(timer, serverTime): `const skew = new Date(serverTime).getTime() - Date.now()` is a NEW computation on every render; and the elapsed expression is `Math.max(now, Date.now()) + skew - new Date(running_since).getTime()`. Substituting: `now ≈ Date.now()` (both captured near render time) ⇒ `Date.now() + (serverTime - Date.now()) = serverTime` (constant). So the displayed elapsed is `max(0, serverTime - running_since)` at the one GET, and never advances with wall clock. Fix: capture `skew` once (useRef on mount) OR compute `const serverNow = new Date(serverTime).getTime() + (now - mountRef.current); const delta = serverNow - new Date(running_since).getTime();`. Verified at API level that elapsed_seconds accumulates correctly on the server (stop after ~2 min returned elapsed_seconds=123).
